title: The wandering hermit dachshund emerges from his burrow
author: AMP2
text: The wandering hermit dachshund emerges from his burrow to scavenge for snacks.
blurb: Wrapped head to tail in a blue camo blanket, this gray-muzzled black-and-tan doxie peeks out from his cozy burrow right next to his dog bed. Their human says the wandering hermit has emerged to scavenge for snacks.
